Here's a setup tailored to weekly alternation between two locations.

- Deodorant
- Any glasses or contacts
- One hair tie or clip
- A small notebook and pen
- Keys

**Duplicate at Each Location**

- Toiletries: shampoo, conditioner, face wash, moisturizer

- Pajamas

- Phone charger (leave one plugged in at each place)
- Laptop charger (if applicable)
- Any work or hobby supplies you use regularly

- [ ] Phone, wallet, keys in pocket/bag
- [ ] Essentials pouch zipped and in bag

- [ ] Any perishables from fridge disposed of or packed
- [ ] Lights off, windows closed
- [ ] One outfit for arrival day laid out or packed
- [ ] Chargers unplugged (except the one staying behind)

**"Arrive" Checklist (first thing when you get there)**

- [ ] Essentials pouch unpacked into bathroom
- [ ] Phone charger plugged in
- [ ] Any fresh groceries or supplies put away
- [ ] Laptop/work setup ready if needed
- [ ] One meal prepped or planned for tonight
- [ ] Bed made or fresh sheets if needed

**Weekly Rhythm**

Sunday evening (or whenever you switch): Do the "Leave" checklist, pack your bag with essentials + any items that travel. Arrive at location B, do the "Arrive" checklist. Takes about 10 minutes total if you're organized.
